name: Bitter Keepsake
text:
Enchant player

Whenever a source controlled by enchanted player deals combat damage to you, put a spite counter on Bitter Keepsake.

Remove three spite counters from Bitter Keepsake and sacrifice it: Return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.

"A grudge is a coal: hold it long enough and you forget which hand is burning." —Elder Zhal, of the Ember Oath
